findings.location: docs/evaluation/gate-k-candidate-lineage.py:120-124 (changed_paths) and :242-243 (protected-prefix enforcement); negative coverage missing in docs/evaluation/test-gate-k-candidate-lineage.sh
findings.summary: The candidate-lineage proof can emit status "pass" and protected status "byte-identical" while a protected path under crates/, fixtures/, xtask/, or .github/workflows/ is deleted or renamed, because git's default rename detection makes `git diff --name-only` omit the protected source path whenever its blob matches a file added under an allowed classification prefix; docs/evaluation already contains byte-identical copies of protected fixtures. Recommended fix: use `git diff --no-renames --name-only -z` in changed_paths and add deletion/rename negative fixtures to the harness.
findings.evidence: Synthetic commit 621bcc4baa024fac9e4b9824e978c19f98470ecf (parent HEAD, tree 5a934666e246cc88e99dced4f3f77f9eb5152c03) deletes fixtures/gaol.commands. `git diff --name-status d8a0b85c55aa33c20f46e5dfd9e0d1f317e1f1c9 621bcc4b...` reports `R100 fixtures/gaol.commands docs/evaluation/runs/rehearsal/2026-08-24-deepseek-debug-gemini-checker-r6/artifacts/repaired.commands`, and `git diff --name-only -z` lists only the docs/evaluation destination, so neither the protected-prefix check nor classify() sees the deleted fixture. `python3 docs/evaluation/gate-k-candidate-lineage.py gate-k-rc1 621bcc4b...` exits 0 with status "pass", changedPaths.count 994 and changedPaths.sha256 789fc728572bb00cd52b7ccef83bebf0454d34275147279e14d0ae2230e11940 (identical to the clean HEAD run), protected.status "byte-identical" — a false pass. Control: deleting fixtures/gaol.replay (no identical twin) is correctly blocked with "protected path changed since gate-k-rc1: fixtures/gaol.replay". `git ls-tree -r HEAD` shows 10 byte-identical copies of fixtures/gaol.nomos (9 under docs/evaluation packet trees), so the base fixture is exposed to the same masking; root-protected files (Cargo.toml etc.) remain covered by the blob comparison.
